item.title: [+1] India-US Trade Deal After US Midterm Results: What Changes
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 15 reports from Univest, Observer Voice, Siliconindia and 2 more. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 30 Oct).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India's services PMI hits four-month high in October as demand picks up
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 9 reports from Business Standard, India Business Trade, www.nationpathindia.com and 6 more. Related: “India’s Services Sector Activity Hits 4-Month High in October, PMI Rises to 55.8”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Silver Rises As A Weaker US Dollar And Falling Treasury Yields Support Sentiment By Kedia Advisory
item.description:
Signal: higher metal prices. 4 reports from Investing.com India, AL Circle. Related: “Zinc Gains As Dollar Index Falls To Five-Week Low Amid Broad Currency Weakness By Kedia Advisory”. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Input costs rise

Why it matters: Rising metal prices lift Indian steel, aluminium and zinc producers while raising input costs for automakers, builders and capital-goods makers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
